test_logical_operators_nans: test DataFrame and Series logical operators with NaN values for and, or operations
test_logical_ops_empty_frame: test DataFrame logical operators (& and |) on empty frames with various index and column configurations
test_logical_ops_bool_frame: test DataFrame logical operators (& and |) on boolean DataFrames
test_logical_ops_int_frame: test logical operator | between integer and boolean DataFrames and Series
test_logical_ops_invalid: test that logical operators raise TypeError for unsupported dtype combinations like float and bool
